description: Non-ergodic based seismic performance assessment of slope systems is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Jorge Macedo, Georgia Institute of Technology (gatech.edu). The state of practice seismic performance assessments of slope systems only consider ergodic approaches. Earthquake engineering is transitioning into non-ergodic approaches; however, most efforts have been focused on hazard quantification, and not much emphasis has been put yet on non-ergodic aspects related to the response of engineering systems (slope systems in the context of this ... Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: Non-ergodic hazard, non-ergodic fragility, seismic performance, slope systems. Published 2024-11-29. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
